It's still there."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"I'm sorry to hear that. It can be so frustrating when creativity feels blocked, especially with everything else you've got going on."},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"Yeah, it's like I want to write, but every time I try, nothing comes out. Plus, everything that's happened recently hasn't helped."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"It sounds like you've been through a lot. That can definitely make it harder to find motivation and focus."},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"Exactly. Between the argument with my ex, failing that mid-term, and falling out with my classmate... I just feel overwhelmed."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"That's a lot to deal with in a short amount of time. It makes sense that you're feeling pressured and overwhelmed."},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"The only positive thing recently is that I found this online community of writers. They've been really encouraging."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"That's wonderful to hear! Having a supportive community can make a huge difference. How have they been helping you?"}]

They've just been really good about listening and offering advice. They're all going through similar struggles, so it's comforting to not feel alone.
